findings.text: non-blocking: the test verifies mast_flux_factor() against TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR and against the declared convention 13, but never the three rows in nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py:92,121,122 that the done_when requires it to check, so a regression reverting those three multiplications to TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR is invisible to the whole suite because the two factors are the same number.

non-blocking: an orphan duplicate of the reconstruction-route paragraph (same text with tests/test_coupled_plant.py and tests/test_unseen_source_full_plant.py swapped) sits outside any section, followed by an unbalanced </section> at line 129 — the fragment carries ten opening and eleven closing section tags, so the artefact the plan indexes renders one section wrongly nested.

non-blocking: the sign-search section records the search's hit count (103 lines, 26 files) but no planted positive control, which the done_when requires, so the claim that no reader carries a sign site rests on an instrument whose sensitivity was never shown to report something known present.

non-blocking: the tests: line is a template carrying <tree>, <shared .venv python> and <one test file per process> rather than a command a shell was handed, and after_suite's command (manifest.md:7) carries PYTHONPATH=<worktree>; promotion builds its gate receipt from that line, so the receipt names no runnable command.
